name: Yuqiao Chen
intro: Building agents that reason, act, and learn.
description: I study how intelligent agents can learn from experience, reason with structured knowledge, and act in the real world.
about: I'm an undergraduate researcher at USTC MIRALab, advised by Prof. Jie Wang. My work focuses on building agentic AI systems that can reason, plan, and learn from experience.

Currently I'm working on credit assignment for multi-step tool-using agents and LLM-guided adaptive tuning for solver configuration. I'm also exploring on-device LLM agent frameworks for mobile platforms.

research.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning
research.description: RL for multi-step tool-using and reasoning agents, self-evolving agentic systems.
